approximate_incremental_1k_to_128k_globa.notes: Inference from end-to-end depth deltas divided by 12 global-attention layers; not a kernel trace.

conclusions: Short capacity-4096 p512 decode is within 0.7070% of Vulkan.
Allocating a capacity above 4096 selects the generic exact split global-attention route; its long-context wall scales far worse than Vulkan cooperative attention.
At d128K Vulkan is 10.843816x faster and retains 60.930315% of d1K throughput, versus 6.361678% for hipEngine.

The next decode priority is capacity-independent exact global attention: first decouple the <=4000-live specialization from allocated capacity, then replace full score-plane/reducer traffic with bounded tiled partials or an exact cooperative online-softmax/PV design.
Prefill is not short-context overtuned: hipEngine beats Vulkan by 1.706981x to 2.271464x across every measured depth and retains a larger fraction of d1K throughput.
